title: pm(check-expected-skips): the roster of jobs allowed to skip is a hand copy of ci.yml's `if:` gates and reds on every new or renamed job — derive the roster from the workflow
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, to the seat's check-retirement sweep and its offer of three cards, verbatim: 「同意」 (the sweep was ordered by 「排查一下还有哪些检查应该退役」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, sweep record 6433263738). ⛔ Not a claim. Batch-of: 11 (director seat, 2026-10-27). Dedupe: 600 newest open + closed issues grepped for the check's file name → 0 unless stated. Part of #26431. Reader: `domain:skills` / devx (`scripts/pm/**`, a seat-protocol surface). Dedupe: #26111 (closed — one instance of exactly this red, `Build UI Deps` missing from the roster) → the class, not the instance.

**Measured:** `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs:264` `EXPECTED_SKIPS` lists job names that may report `skipped` and, per job, the kind of `if:` gate it carries; its self-test `auditRoster` (:402) re-reads ci.yml. The roster also hard-codes the shard sizes (/3, /8, /16 at :316, :330, :359). #26111 (2026-10-26): a job added in #25963 was missing, so every PR with an empty ui scope went red until the roster was edited. Wired at `lint.yml` repo-tooling (`check:pm-expected-skips`).

**Wanted:** derive the roster from `ci.yml` itself — a job whose `if:` references the filter outputs or the two per-PR events is an expected skipper; matrix sizes read from the `matrix:` blocks — keeping the gate's real question ("was this skip expected, or did a required job silently not run?") and removing the hand list; the self-test proves the derivation on the live file. **Acceptance:** adding or renaming a gated job in ci.yml needs no edit in `scripts/pm`; `--self-test` green; `check:ci-filter-parity` and `check-required-contexts` unchanged. **Size:** S. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
